readerCopy.body: A current limit may show you which old responsibility still has too much authority over your choices. When Saturn opposes the South Node, a deadline, rule, boss, contract, or practical constraint can force a comparison between what you are responsible for now and what you have simply continued carrying. The old commitment may have been necessary once. That does not make it permanent. Give the present obligation the weight it actually deserves.
